stated_limitation: Since the layer of the reference channel is unknown, absolute phase values are convention-dependent; the robust results are the prevalence, strength, and cell-type specificity of the entrainment.

justification.dataset: DANDI 000044 Achilles CA1 tetrode/LFP linear-maze session is the canonical dataset for hippocampal theta entrainment.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile, running bouts restricted, ≥50-spike inclusion applied, and a genuine timestamp-quirk in the position series is correctly diagnosed and reconstructed.
justification.analysis: Proper circular statistics (MRL, Rayleigh test, preferred phase) with a random-time control that preserves spike count and the marginal phase distribution.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (104/137, 88/120, 16/17, median MRLs 0.109/0.259, control 0.019, MW p=5.7e-5) reproduces exactly from the committed CSV and code.
justification.figures: Figures are labeled with units and sample sizes and clearly show the effect; example units are ranked by MRL, which is the effect strength itself, so selection is legitimate.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to the evidence and the write-up explicitly names the single-reference-channel and unknown-layer caveats, distinguishing robust from convention-dependent findings.
